Table ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

AsamTable displays supplied rows and handles selection, sorting and local presentation. Pair it with Table column to define columns. Use Data table when a data source owns requests and paging.

Data and columns ​

Pass rows with data. Use a stable row-key field path or getter. A column’s prop can target a nested field path. Common patterns include fixed columns, grouped headers, expandable rows, filtering and summaries.

Table density and empty results ​

Example: basic

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<label>
			<span>表格行高</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="size">
				<AsamOption
					v-for="value in sizes"
					:key="value"
					:label="'size=' + value"
					:value="value"
				>
					size={{ value }}
				</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="loading = !loading">
			切换本地加载状态
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" plain native-type="button" @click="empty = !empty">
			{{ empty ? '恢复本地记录' : '查看空状态' }}
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTable
			v-bind="{ data: empty ? [] : rows, rowKey: 'id', selectable: true, loading, size }"
			@selection-change="selection = $event"
		>
			<template #toolbar="{ selection: current }">
				<span>已选 {{ current.length }} 项</span>
			</template>
			<!-- @vue-generic {Row} -->
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="名称" min-width="150">
				<template #default="{ row }">
					<span>{{ row.name }}</span>
				</template>
			</AsamTableColumn>
			<AsamTableColumn
				v-bind="{ prop: 'count', label: '数量', sortable: true, width: 100 }"
			/>
			<template #empty>没有本地记录</template>
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">
			选中键：{{ selection.map((row) => row.id).join(', ') }}
		</p>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableSize } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	count: number;
}
const rows: Row[] = [
	{ id: 1, name: '本地草稿', count: 3 },
	{ id: 2, name: '已发布记录', count: 8 },
	{ id: 3, name: '待审核记录', count: 0 },
	{ id: 4, name: '已归档记录', count: 12 },
	{ id: 5, name: '已撤回记录', count: 3 }
];
const selection = ref<Row[]>([]);
const loading = ref(false);
const empty = ref(false);
const sizes: AsamTableSize[] = ['large', 'default', 'small', 'mini'];
const size = ref<AsamTableSize>('default');
</script>

AsamTableSize offers large, default, small and mini, with single-line row heights of 60px, 50px, 42px and 36px. Multiline and custom content may increase row height. Stripes are enabled by default and borders are opt-in. Customize the empty state through the empty slot. Compare table states.

Tree selection and lazy loading ​

Example: tree-defaults

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="customChildren">使用 nodes 子节点字段</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="staticTable?.clearSelection()">
			清除树默认选择
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTable
			ref="staticTable"
			:data="rows"
			row-key="id"
			selectable
			default-expand-all
			:default-selected-row-keys="[11]"
			:tree-props="{ children: customChildren ? 'nodes' : 'children', checkStrictly: true }"
			@selection-change="recordStatic"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="静态树" />
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="tree-default-static">
			静态选择 {{ staticSelection.join(',') }}
		</p>
		<AsamTable
			:data="lazyRows"
			row-key="id"
			selectable
			lazy
			:default-selected-row-keys="[21]"
			:tree-props="{ children: 'children', hasChildren: 'hasChildren', checkStrictly: true }"
			:load="load"
			@selection-change="recordLazy"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="label" label="懒加载树（展开后解析默认选择）" />
		</AsamTable>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="tree-default-lazy">
			懒加载选择 {{ lazySelection.join(',') }}
		</p>
	</div>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableTreeDefaultsDemo' });
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Row {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Row[];
	nodes?: Row[];
	hasChildren?: boolean;
}
const customChildren = ref(false);
const staticTable = shallowRef<AsamTableExpose<Row>>();
const staticSelection = ref<number[]>([]),
	lazySelection = ref<number[]>([]);
const rows = computed<Row[]>(() => [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: '父节点',
		[customChildren.value ? 'nodes' : 'children']: [
			{ id: 11, label: '默认选中子节点' },
			{ id: 12, label: '其他子节点' }
		]
	}
]);
const lazyRows: Row[] = [{ id: 2, label: '待加载父节点', hasChildren: true }];
const timers = new Set<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
let disposed = false;
function recordStatic(selection: Row[]): void {
	staticSelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
function recordLazy(selection: Row[]): void {
	lazySelection.value = selection.map((row) => row.id);
}
const load: AsamTableProps<Row>['load'] = (_row, _node, resolve) => {
	const timer = setTimeout(() => {
		timers.delete(timer);
		if (!disposed) resolve([{ id: 21, label: '解析后默认选中子节点' }]);
	}, 150);
	timers.add(timer);
};
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	disposed = true;
	timers.forEach((timer) => clearTimeout(timer));
	timers.clear();
});
</script>

.demo-root-layout {

	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
}
.demo-root-layout > :is(p, pre, output) {

}
</style>

getSelectionRows() returns fully selected rows. With checkStrictly: false, getHalfSelectionRows() returns partially selected parents. getSelection() provides ASAM’s current selection snapshot. Newly loaded descendants can inherit a pending default-selection intent. Try selection with lazy-loaded tree rows.

Instance methods and state ​

Read top-level exposed views such as isEmpty, columns and tableLayout directly from the mounted instance. Call doLayout() to recompute layout. Use the published type reference for the complete selection, scroll, sorting and filter methods.

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageCheckStrictlyDemo' });
import { AsamRadioGroup, AsamRadioButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { reactive } from 'vue';

interface User {
	id: number;
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
	hasChildren?: boolean;
	children?: User[];
}

const treeProps = reactive({
	checkStrictly: false
});

const selectable = (row: User) => ![1, 31].includes(row.id);

const tableData: User[] = [

<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="resetDateFilter">重置日期筛选</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="clearFilter">重置全部筛选条件</AsamButton>
		<AsamTable ref="tableRef" row-key="date" :data="tableData" style="width: 100%">
			<AsamTableColumn
				prop="date"
				label="日期"
				sortable
				width="180"
				column-key="date"
				:filters="[
					{ text: '2016-05-01', value: '2016-05-01' },
					{ text: '2016-05-02', value: '2016-05-02' },
					{ text: '2016-05-03', value: '2016-05-03' },
					{ text: '2016-05-04', value: '2016-05-04' }
				]"
				:filter-method="filterHandler"
			/>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="姓名" width="180" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="address" label="地址" :formatter="formatter" />

			<!-- @vue-generic {User} -->
			<AsamTableColumn
				prop="tag"
				label="标签"
				width="100"
				:filters="[
					{ text: '家', value: '家' },
					{ text: '办公室', value: '办公室' }
				]"
				:filter-method="filterTag"
				filter-placement="bottom-end"
			>
				<template #default="scope">
					<AsamTag
						:type="scope.row.tag === '家' ? 'primary' : 'success'"
						disable-transitions
					>
						{{ scope.row.tag }}
					</AsamTag>
				</template>
			</AsamTableColumn>
		</AsamTable>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFilterDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
	tag: string;
}

const tableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();

const resetDateFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter(['date']);
};
const clearFilter = () => {
	tableRef.value!.clearFilter();
};
const formatter = (row: User) => {
	return row.address;
};
const filterTag = (value: string, row: User) => {
	return row.tag === value;
};
const filterHandler = (value: string, row: User, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>) => {
	const property = column['property'];
	return property in row && Reflect.get(row, property) === value;
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '家'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '办公室'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-04',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '家'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '汤姆',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		tag: '办公室'
	}
];
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageFixedHeaderWithFluidHeaderDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

const now = new Date();

const tableData = ref([
	{
		date: '2016-05-01',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-02',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	},
	{
		date: '2016-05-03',
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	}
]);

const deleteRow = (index: number) => {
	tableData.value.splice(index, 1);
};

const onAddItem = () => {
	now.setDate(now.getDate() + 1);
	tableData.value.push({
		date: now.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
		name: '汤姆',
		state: '加利福尼亚州',
		city: '洛杉矶',
		address: '洛杉矶格罗夫街 189 号',
		zip: 'CA 90036'
	});
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageMultiSelectDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTableExpose } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: number;
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
}

const multipleTableRef = ref<AsamTableExpose<User>>();
const multipleSelection = ref<User[]>([]);

const selectable = (row: User) => ![1, 2].includes(row.id);
const toggleSelection = (rows?: User[], ignoreSelectable?: boolean) => {
	if (rows) {
		rows.forEach((row) => {
			multipleTableRef.value!.toggleRowSelection(row, undefined, ignoreSelectable);
		});
	} else {
		multipleTableRef.value!.clearSelection();
	}
};
const handleSelectionChange = (val: User[]) => {

};

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageRowspanAndColspanDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SpanMethodProps {
	row: User;
	column: AsamTableColumnCtx<User>;
	rowIndex: number;
	columnIndex: number;
}

const arraySpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
		if (columnIndex === 0) {
			return [1, 2];
		} else if (columnIndex === 1) {
			return [0, 0];
		}
	}
};

const objectSpanMethod = ({ rowIndex, columnIndex }: SpanMethodProps) => {
	if (columnIndex === 0) {
		if (rowIndex % 2 === 0) {
			return {
				rowspan: 2,
				colspan: 1
			};
		} else {
			return {
				rowspan: 0,
				colspan: 0
			};
		}
	}
};

const tableData: User[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10
	},
	{
		id: '12987123',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '165',
		amount2: '4.43',
		amount3: 12
	},
	{
		id: '12987124',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '324',
		amount2: '1.9',
		amount3: 9
	},
	{
		id: '12987125',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '621',
		amount2: '2.2',
		amount3: 17
	},
	{
		id: '12987126',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '539',
		amount2: '4.1',
		amount3: 15
	}
];
</script>

			show-summary
			style="width: 100%; margin-top: var(--asam-space-lg)"
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="id" label="ID" width="180" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="姓名" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="amount1" label="费用 1 ($)" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="amount2" label="费用 2 ($)" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="amount3" label="费用 3 ($)" />
		</AsamTable>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageSummaryDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Product {
	id: string;
	name: string;
	amount1: string;
	amount2: string;
	amount3: number;
}

interface SummaryMethodProps<T extends Product = Product> {
	columns: AsamTableColumnCtx<T>[];
	data: T[];
}

const getSummaries = (param: SummaryMethodProps) => {
	const { columns, data } = param;
	const sums: (string | VNode)[] = [];
	columns.forEach((column, index) => {
		if (index === 0) {
			sums[index] = h('div', { style: { textDecoration: 'underline' } }, ['总费用']);
			return;
		}
		const values = data.map((item) => Number(Reflect.get(item, column.property)));
		if (!values.every((value) => Number.isNaN(value))) {
			sums[index] = `$ ${values.reduce((prev, curr) => {
				const value = Number(curr);
				if (!Number.isNaN(value)) {
					return prev + curr;
				} else {
					return prev;
				}
			}, 0)}`;
		} else {
			sums[index] = 'N/A';
		}
	});

	return sums;
};

const tableData: Product[] = [
	{
		id: '12987122',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '234',
		amount2: '3.2',
		amount3: 10
	},
	{
		id: '12987123',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '165',
		amount2: '4.43',
		amount3: 12
	},
	{
		id: '12987124',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '324',
		amount2: '1.9',
		amount3: 9
	},
	{
		id: '12987125',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '621',
		amount2: '2.2',
		amount3: 17
	},
	{
		id: '12987126',
		name: '汤姆',
		amount1: '539',
		amount2: '4.1',
		amount3: 15
	}
];
</script>

<template>
	<div>
		<p class="example-paragraph">追加内容位于汇总行上方；固定高度时滚动到底部查看追加操作。</p>
		<label>
			<span>布局</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="layout">
				<AsamOption :label="'auto'" :value="'auto'">auto</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption :label="'fixed'" :value="'fixed'">fixed</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</label>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="showSummary">汇总</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="showAppend">追加内容</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="empty">空表</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="customSummary">自定义 VNode 汇总</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="fixedHeight">固定高度</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamTable
			:data="visibleRows"
			:table-layout="layout"
			:show-summary="showSummary"
			:summary-method="customSummary ? summaries : undefined"
			:height="fixedHeight ? 260 : undefined"
			row-key="id"
			border
		>
			<AsamTableColumn prop="name" label="商品" min-width="160" />
			<AsamTableColumn prop="amount" label="数量" min-width="120" />
			<template v-if="showAppend" #append>
				<div class="append-actions">
					<AsamButton type="primary" @click="add">追加一行</AsamButton>
					<span>已追加 {{ added }} 行</span>
				</div>
			</template>
			<template #empty>暂无商品，可通过追加操作添加。</template>
		</AsamTable>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableAppendSummaryDemo' });
import { computed, h, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamTable,
	AsamTableColumn
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamTableProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Product {
	id: number;
	name: string;
	amount: number;
}
const layout = ref<'auto' | 'fixed'>('auto');
const showSummary = ref(true),
	showAppend = ref(true),
	empty = ref(false);
const customSummary = ref(false),
	fixedHeight = ref(false),
	added = ref(0);
const rows = ref<Product[]>([
	{ id: 1, name: '商品 A', amount: 2 },
	{ id: 2, name: '商品 B', amount: 3 }
]);
const visibleRows = computed(() => (empty.value ? [] : rows.value));
const summaries: NonNullable<AsamTableProps<Product>['summaryMethod']> = ({ data }) => [
	h('strong', '数量合计'),
	String(data.reduce((sum, row) => sum + row.amount, 0))
];
function add() {
	const id = rows.value.length + 1;
	rows.value.push({ id, name: `商品 ${id}`, amount: 1 });
	added.value++;
	empty.value = false;
}
</script>

					{{ tag }}
				</AsamTag>
			</template>
		</AsamTableColumn>
		<AsamTableColumn prop="url" label="使用 VNode" width="240" :tooltip-formatter="withVNode" />
	</AsamTable>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageTooltipFormatterDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn, AsamTag } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { h } from 'vue';
import { AsamLink, type AsamTableTooltipData } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type TableData = {
	address: string;
	tags: string[];
	url: string;
};

const tableData: TableData[] = [
	{
		address: '萨尔州南莉莉洛尔贝格路 86c 号',
		tags: ['办公室', '家', '公园', '花园'],
		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'
	},
	{
		address: '伊利诺伊州南弗兰克菲尔德 A 街 760 号',
		tags: ['error', 'warning', 'success', 'info'],
		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'
	},
	{
		address: '图林根州阿尔特马利纳沙伊德阿诺德路 41a 号',
		tags: ['one', 'two', 'three', 'four', 'five'],
		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'
	},
	{
		address: '爱达荷州西里卡多温莎路 23618 号',
		tags: ['blue', 'white', 'dark', 'gray', 'red', 'bright'],
		url: '/component-AsamTable.html'
	}
];

const tableRowFormatter = (data: AsamTableTooltipData<TableData>) => {
	return `${data.cellValue}：表格格式化内容`;
};

const withVNode = (data: AsamTableTooltipData<TableData>) => {
	return h(AsamLink, { type: 'primary', href: data.cellValue }, () =>
		h('span', null, data.cellValue)
	);
};
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTableUsageWithStatusDemo' });
import { AsamTable, AsamTableColumn } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface User {
	date: string;
	name: string;
	address: string;
}

const tableRowClassName = ({ rowIndex }: { row: User; rowIndex: number }) => {
	if (rowIndex === 1) {
		return 'warning-row';
	} else if (rowIndex === 3) {
		return 'success-row';
	}
	return '';
};

import type { VNode } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableProps, AsamTableSize, AsamTableRowKeyGetter, AsamTableRowKey, AsamPaginationProps, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamControlSize, AsamTableSummaryMethod, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableColumnCls, AsamTableColumnStyle, AsamTableV2HeaderCellSlotProps, AsamTableCellCls, AsamTableCellStyle, AsamTableSort, AsamTableTreeNode, AsamTableOverflowTooltipFormatter } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableProps
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	"size"?: AsamTableSize | undefined;
	"data"?: Row[] | undefined;
	"stripe"?: boolean | undefined;
	"border"?: boolean | undefined;
	"tableLayout"?: ("auto" | "fixed") | undefined;

	"loading"?: boolean | undefined;
	"minWidth"?: string | undefined;
	"pagination"?: AsamPaginationProps | undefined;
	"allowDragLastColumn"?: boolean | undefined;
	"preserveExpandedContent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"style"?: AsamTableProps<Row>["style"];
	"className"?: string | undefined;
	"width"?: string | number | undefined;
	"height"?: string | number | undefined;
	"maxHeight"?: string | number | undefined;
	"fit"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showHeader"?: boolean | undefined;
	"showSummary"?: boolean | undefined;
	"sumText"?: string | undefined;
	"summaryMethod"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["summaryMethod"];
	"rowClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowClassName"];
	"rowStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowStyle"];
	"cellClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["cellClassName"];
	"cellStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["cellStyle"];
	"headerRowClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerRowClassName"];
	"headerRowStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerRowStyle"];
	"headerCellClassName"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerCellClassName"];
	"headerCellStyle"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["headerCellStyle"];
	"highlightCurrentRow"?: boolean | undefined;
	"currentRowKey"?: string | number | undefined;
	"emptyText"?: string | undefined;
	"expandRowKeys"?: string[] | undefined;
	"defaultExpandAll"?: boolean | undefined;
	"rowExpandable"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["rowExpandable"];
	"defaultSort"?: AsamTableSort | undefined;

	"tooltipOptions"?: (AsamTableProps<Row>)["tooltipOptions"];

import type { AsamTableEmits, AsamTableColumnCtx } from '@asam-ui/ui';

// AsamTableEmits
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	"select": [selection: Row[], row: Row];
	"select-all": [selection: Row[]];
	"selection-change": [selection: Row[]];
	"cell-mouse-enter": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];
	"cell-mouse-leave": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];
	"cell-contextmenu": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: PointerEvent];
	"cell-click": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: PointerEvent];
	"cell-dblclick": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, cell: HTMLTableCellElement, event: MouseEvent];
	"row-click": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row> | null, event: PointerEvent];
	"row-contextmenu": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row> | null, event: PointerEvent];
	"row-dblclick": [row: Row, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row> | null, event: MouseEvent];
	"header-click": [column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, event: PointerEvent];
	"header-contextmenu": [column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, event: PointerEvent];
	"sort-change": [sort: { column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>; prop: string | null; order: "ascending" | "descending" | null; }];
	"filter-change": [filters: Record<string, string[]>];
	"current-change": [currentRow: Row | null, oldCurrentRow: Row | null];
	"header-dragend": [newWidth: number, oldWidth: number, column: AsamTableColumnCtx<Row>, event: MouseEvent];
	"expand-change": [row: Row, expanded: boolean | Row[]];
	"scroll": [position: { scrollLeft: number; scrollTop: number; }];
	"page-change": [page: number];
	"page-size-change": [pageSize: number];
};

import type { VNode, Ref, ReactiveEffect, ConcreteComponent, ComputedOptions, MethodOptions, AppContext, RendererNode, RendererElement, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTableExpose, AsamTableContext, AsamTableRefs, AsamTableColumnCtx, AsamTableSize, AsamTableNativeEmits, AsamTableSort, AsamTableV2Expose, AsamTableV2Props, AsamTableFilter, AsamTableOverflowTooltipOptions, AsamScrollbarDirection } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTableExpose
type PublicContract<Row extends object = object> = {
	readonly "sort": (prop: string, order: string) => void;
	readonly "context": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["context"];
	readonly "tableLayout": "auto" | "fixed";
	readonly "allowDragLastColumn": boolean;
	readonly "ns": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["ns"];
	readonly "layout": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["layout"];
	readonly "store": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["store"];
	readonly "columns": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["columns"];
	readonly "handleMouseLeave": () => void;
	readonly "tableId": string;
	readonly "tableSize": "" | "large" | "default" | "small";
	readonly "isHidden": boolean;
	readonly "isEmpty": boolean;
	readonly "renderExpanded": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["renderExpanded"];
	readonly "resizeProxyVisible": boolean;
	readonly "resizeState": { width: null | number; height: null | number; headerHeight: null | number; };
	readonly "isGroup": boolean;
	readonly "bodyWidth": string;
	readonly "tableBodyStyles": { width: string; };
	readonly "emptyBlockStyle": { width: string; height: string; } | undefined;
	readonly "debouncedUpdateLayout": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["debouncedUpdateLayout"];
	readonly "setCurrentRow": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["setCurrentRow"];
	readonly "getSelectionRows": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["getSelectionRows"];
	readonly "getHalfSelectionRows": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["getHalfSelectionRows"];
	readonly "toggleRowSelection": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["toggleRowSelection"];
	readonly "clearSelection": () => void;
	readonly "clearFilter": (columnKeys?: string[] | string) => void;
	readonly "toggleAllSelection": () => void;
	readonly "toggleRowExpansion": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["toggleRowExpansion"];
	readonly "clearSort": () => void;
	readonly "doLayout": () => void;
	readonly "updateKeyChildren": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["updateKeyChildren"];
	readonly "t": AsamTableExpose<Row>["t"];
	readonly "setDragVisible": (visible: boolean) => void;
	readonly "computedSumText": string;
	readonly "computedEmptyText": string;
	readonly "computedTooltipEffect": string | undefined;
	readonly "computedTooltipOptions": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["computedTooltipOptions"];
	readonly "scrollbarViewStyle": { display: string; verticalAlign: string; };
	readonly "scrollbarStyle": { height: string; maxHeight?: undefined; } | { maxHeight: string; height?: undefined; } | { height?: undefined; maxHeight?: undefined; };
	readonly "scrollTo": (options: ScrollToOptions | number, yCoord?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollLeft": (left?: number) => void;
	readonly "setScrollTop": (top?: number) => void;
	readonly "scrollBarRef": (AsamTableExpose<Row>)["scrollBarRef"];
	readonly "handleHeaderFooterMousewheel": (event: WheelEvent, delta: { pixelX: number; pixelY: number; }) => void;
	"getSelection": () => Row[];
};
